retracted_why: MEASURES NOTHING. This model wrote 2,981 cells with residual tail==1.0 on every one: no token cleared theta as a word start, so the beam expanded nothing and zero word rows were emitted. A beam that does no work is fast, which is why this was the fastest rate ever recorded here (previous floor 0.155) and 4x faster than its own 1.5B sibling. Struck 2026-08-21 after @dario found the two arms have cells but no words; see docket [6479] [6480] [6481]. rate_for() must not return this.
